strings.frame.layers.tip: Click to select; drag up or down to change the stacking order. Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down also move it
strings.frame.mode.tip: Place: drag to move, and drag corners or edges to resize. Crop: drag edges to cut the video
strings.frame.flip.tip: Mirrors the video left to right
strings.frame.allow-outside.tip: Lets the video move beyond the stream screen
strings.frame.crop-mode.tip: Drag the edges to cut the video
strings.frame.reset-crop.tip: Stops cropping and zooming, and shows the whole video
strings.frame.fit.tip: Makes the video as large as fits on the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.fill.tip: Makes the video cover the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.center.tip: Moves the video to the center of the stream screen without resizing it
strings.frame.forward.tip: Swaps places with the video just in front
strings.frame.backward.tip: Swaps places with the video just behind
strings.frame.front.tip: Shows the video in front of the others
strings.frame.back.tip: Shows the video behind the others
strings.error.unexpected: Something went wrong and the action could not be completed. Please try again.
strings.preview.label: Stream preview
strings.preview.frame-rate.tip: Stream frame rate. Below the set rate the video looks choppy
strings.preview.exit-fullscreen: Leaves full screen and returns to the normal view
strings.preview.fullscreen-hint: Press Esc or F to return
strings.notice.failure.title: Couldn't complete the action
